source.author: ov
source.text: pars clipeos rudibus, galeas pars tundit inanes: hoc Curetes habent, hoc Corybantes opus.
source.text_original: pars clipeos rudibus, galeas pars tundit inanes:   / hoc Curetes habent, hoc Corybantes opus.
source.text_english: Some beat shields into rough shape, others hollow helmets: this is the work of the Curetes, this the work of the Corybantes.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: pars clipeos sudibus, galeas pars tundit inanes, hoc Curetes habent, hoc Corybantes opus.
reuse.text_original: pars clipeos sudibus, galeas pars tundit inanes, hoc Curetes habent, hoc Corybantes opus.
reuse.text_english: Some beat hollow shields and some helmets with clubs; this is the work the Curetes have, this the Corybantes.
